import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

N, T = map(int, input().split())
scores = [0] * N

# freq_map will store frequency of each score value
freq_map = {0: N}
distinct_count = 1

for _ in range(T):
    A, B = map(int, input().split())
    A -= 1  # 0-based index
    
    old_score = scores[A]
    new_score = old_score + B
    
    # decrease frequency of old_score
    freq_map[old_score] -= 1
    if freq_map[old_score] == 0:
        del freq_map[old_score]
        distinct_count -= 1
    
    # increase frequency of new_score
    freq_map[new_score] = freq_map.get(new_score, 0) + 1
    if freq_map[new_score] == 1:
        distinct_count += 1
    
    scores[A] = new_score
    
    print(distinct_count)
```
